summary_en: Nippon Ceramic authorized acquisition of up to 550,000 shares (2.75% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 1.5 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 18, 2026 to January 29, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 17, 2026, Nippon Ceramic's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock under Article 165(3) of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 550,000 shares, representing 2.75% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum outlay of 1.5 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

The acquisition period runs from November 18, 2026 through January 29, 2027. The company stated the purpose of this buyback is to improve capital efficiency as measured by ROE, enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions, and enhance shareholder returns. The authorization was decided at the Board meeting held on the announcement date in accordance with the Company Law and the company's Articles of Incorporation.
